Name: }bedrock.migrate.cube

Parameters.Name: pCube
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Cube name, wildcard pattern, '&'-separated list, or JSON Array of names/patterns

Parameters.Name: pSourceConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Source connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it (blank = this database)

Parameters.Name: pTargetConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Target connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it (blank = this database)

Parameters.Name: pIncludeControlObjects
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Include control objects (names starting with }) that match the pattern (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pIncludeDimensions
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: 1 = copy the cube's dimensions to the target first, 0 = use the target's dimensions and fail if one is missing (Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
